answer_1.quote: Our goal is to automatically generate a popular science article based on a technical paper and improve the accessibility of the generated article to the general audience.

answer_2.quote: Following Goldsack et al. (2022); Cardenas et al. (2023), we use the Coleman-Liau Index (CLI, Coleman and Liau (1975)), the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL, Kincaid et al. (1975)) and the Dale-Chall Readability Score (DCRS, Dale and Chall (1948)) to automatically assess readability.

answer_3.quote: Therefore, we let an editor (the third LLM) evaluate the correctness and comprehensiveness of the reader's notes and then provide suggestions for the revision of the journalist's article.

answer_4.quote: Four human participants are enlisted for evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are tasked with evaluating the articles using a 1-5 Likert scale, grounded on specific questions.
